records.whole_exchange_context:

AE loves that red precisely because it stirs passion and recalls the consuming love of her younger days. AF offers a reserved pause and politely detached acknowledgment. AE abruptly turns from reminiscence to business:prepare tomato dishes and start selling them at once. AF agrees. AE emphasizes not letting this tomato fashion pass them by. AF gives a casual repeated acknowledgment. AE encourages the effort and ends with the same elaborate self-satisfied laugh. An impersonal FE notice then predicts that tomatoes seem likely to catch on in ジェノヴァ. Preserve enthusiasm,color-based skepticism,passionate reminiscence,deadpan politeness,practical orders, compliance,exhortation,offhand acknowledgment and grand confidence,then the shift to impersonal prospective news.

Preserve the red and the stirring of passion;do not substitute B176's taste-based argument. AF's skeptical red-food question does not assert that tomatoes are poisonous,unsafe or inedible. AE loves that red precisely because it stirs passion and recalls the consuming love of her younger days. AF offers a reserved pause and politely detached acknowledgment. AE abruptly turns from reminiscence to business:prepare tomato dishes and start selling them at once. AF agrees. AE emphasizes not letting this tomato fashion pass them by. AF gives a casual repeated acknowledgment. AE encourages the effort and ends with the same elaborate self-satisfied laugh. An impersonal FE notice then predicts that tomatoes seem likely to catch on in ジェノヴァ. Preserve enthusiasm,color-based skepticism,passionate reminiscence,deadpan politeness,practical orders, compliance,exhortation,offhand acknowledgment and grand confidence,then the shift to impersonal prospective news.

The native AE/AF names and voices remain to bind;source selectors alone are not permission to copy a character name from predecessor English. The recollection is AE's own youthful romance;it identifies no lover and proves no romance, marriage or kinship with AF. 身を焦がすような恋 is consuming/burning romantic passion,not literal injury or a named affair. Preserve the red and the stirring of passion;do not substitute B176's taste-based argument. AF's skeptical red-food question does not assert that tomatoes are poisonous,unsafe or inedible. Add no historical food taboo. The detached よかったですね can sound dry in this exchange;do not turn it into enthusiastic shared nostalgia,flirtation or a new insult. The brief 分かりました is polite compliance;later へいへい is casual/resigned repeated acknowledgment.

The immediate instruction concerns cooking tomato dishes and putting them on sale,not buying a stated quantity, already making money,shipping cargo or completing a sale. AE treats the tomato fashion as an opportunity in her own speech;the closing narrator retains しそう as prospective likelihood rather than an already earned or guaranteed boom. The city is explicit only in that closing notice. Do not assign the earlier scene a location,make an unsupported chronological connection to B176,or infer noble rank/employment hierarchy from the elaborate laugh and imperatives.
